"Um, something like that.  Actually I'm just half-dragon, but that's enough that getting my head chopped off doesn't kill me."

Do you get those muscles without exercising?  Can you eat junk food and still have those?"
"Yeah, my blood and guts are like that.  I was born with these muscles.  No, I don't have to exercise to have them, and yes, I still have them
with no body fat if I eat junk food.  I was born half zarakite dragon, and lifting weights and working out is just a waste of time because I'm
like this no matter what.  Some half dragons like me are born with little muscles, like my girlfriend \P[2] here, and I was born with these
bigger ones.  We half dragons are stuck with our muscles life-long, as long as we're half dragons that is."
"Full-blooded zarakites can turn pure humans into half-dragons sometimes, and also make some half dragons into pure humans.  I've got a tigerstone
face, so I can't be flipped back-and-forth like that.  I'll pretty much always be a half dragon."

"I heard monsters took over the warehouse and no one can go in there."
"Did you get your head cut off?  You look funny carrying your head like that."
"I have some glue I use at school.  My mom has a stapler in her desk.  My dad has duct tape in his-"
"Whoa, easy there, big guy.  I know how to fix it, just let me worry about my severed head.  Thanks though."
"Hi there.  Stay away from the town's storage warehouse.  Its normally off-limits to people anyways, but its been over-run by monsters!
The local town authorities and town elder are working on it, but until they fix the problem I wouldn't go anywhere near the building!"
"Hi there.  Be careful if you go near the town storage warehouse.  It was recently cleaned out after getting over-run by monsters.  Until they
finish cleaning everything up, I'd stay away from the building.  Some outsiders and our town's head samurai, Taro, went in and kicked some
monster butt from one end of the warehouse to the other.  Thanks to them we still have a warehouse there, and a town!"
"Hi mister.  This is the town's cafe, and that big building to the south is the factory.  The Inn is way over there to the west before you get
to the end of town.  South in our town are apartments where everyone lives.  In the center of town is where the elder lives and runs everything."
"Sure mister.  And there's a pharmacy store right over there just west of the cafe where you could get a healing potion or something
to glue your head back on."
"Thanks big guy, but I know how to re-attach it.  I just eat enough food, and it'll grow back on."
"Those people who call themselves 'Golden Fox people' - I heard they are slime.  Its so nice to live here and not have them anywhere on our island."
"Uh huh.  Can you tell us anything about your town?  We're visiting."
"Well as you don't let in any Golden Fox stink, you're good."
"There's a potion store in the northeast corner of town where you could get a healing potion, and glue your head back on, mister."
"Thanks, but I can get myself back together if I eat some food sometimes, or get a good rest first."
"The town's cafe is right next to the potion store, and if you want to rest, the Inn is in the northwest corner of town."
"I don't know if you'd have to pay for two beds for your two parts!"
"Probably not, but I'll work it out with the InnKeeper.  Thanks for the help."
"We Red Hawk Folk have been fighting the Golden Fox people for years.  We teach our children to protect themselves against them and fight them,
but that's mainly because our parents and schoolteachers taught us the same.  It makes me wonder sometimes..."
"I'm SO glad I live here instead of one of the Golden Fox people!  Especially with the GROSS things they do with their bathroom toilet paper!"
"You mean how they set up their toilet paper on a roll so it comes off the roll rolling toward themselves, right?"
"Well yeah!  That's disgusting!  I can't imagine living like that!"
"The Castle of the Dark is far off to the southwest on another island.  You can reach the far side of it by going south and following bridges
that connect different islands, but beware of huge monster crocodiles that live under some of the bridges."
